s1.syndrome_frame: Ocular inflammation with eyelid involvement and conjunctival hyperemia in a patient with a history of autoimmune disease
salient_findings: Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids
Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins
key_facts: Switched to adalimumab due to disease relapse
Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins
Rest of the ophthalmic examination was unremarkable

raw.syndrome_frame: Ocular inflammation with eyelid involvement and conjunctival hyperemia in a patient with a history of autoimmune disease
salient_findings: Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids

key_facts: Switched to adalimumab due to disease relapse
Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins

shortlist.label: Blepharitis
shortlist.why_kept: Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous eyelids with crusty plaques on the eyelid margins

shortlist.label: Crohn disease-associated ocular inflammation
shortlist.why_kept: History of biopsy-proven Crohn disease and ocular inflammation

shortlist.label: Infliximab-induced ocular inflammation
shortlist.why_kept: Initial treatment with infliximab and subsequent ocular inflammation

shortlist.label: Adalimumab-induced ocular inflammation
shortlist.why_kept: Switch to adalimumab due to disease relapse and ongoing ocular inflammation

shortlist.label: Eczematous blepharoconjunctivitis
shortlist.why_kept: Bilateral eyelid involvement and diffuse conjunctival hyperemia

shortlist.label: Seborrheic blepharitis
shortlist.why_kept: Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins and eyelid involvement

shortlist.label: Atopic keratoconjunctivitis
shortlist.why_kept: History of autoimmune disease and ocular inflammation

shortlist.label: Tumor necrosis factor-alpha inhibitor-associated blepharitis
shortlist.why_kept: Treatment with TNF-alpha inhibitors and subsequent blepharitis

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous eyelids, ectropion, and conjunctival hyperemia, which improved after discontinuation of TNF-α inhibitors, are consistent with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Blepharitis
rejected.why: Too general, does not account for the specific association with TNF-α inhibitors

rejected.label: Crohn disease-associated ocular inflammation
rejected.why: The patient's ocular symptoms do not seem to be directly related to the Crohn disease activity

rejected.label: Infliximab-induced ocular inflammation
rejected.why: The patient switched to adalimumab and still experienced symptoms, suggesting a class effect of TNF-α inhibitors

rejected.label: Adalimumab-induced ocular inflammation
rejected.why: Similar to infliximab, this diagnosis does not account for the improvement after discontinuation of TNF-α inhibitors

rejected.label: Eczematous blepharoconjunctivitis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms do not seem to be part of a broader eczematous condition

rejected.label: Seborrheic blepharitis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms do not seem to be related to seborrhea

rejected.label: Atopic keratoconjunctivitis
rejected.why: There is no mention of atopy or other allergic symptoms

rejected.label: Crohn disease-associated ocular inflammation
rejected.why: The patient's ocular symptoms seem to be more directly related to the TNF-α inhibitor treatment
